messages.subject: Error using STATeT in Eclipse (problems with run button)
messages.subject_clean: Error using STATeT in Eclipse (problems with run button)
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I've got a little problem with R, and I don't know where it comes from.


I have just finished installing R 3.1.0, Eclipse Luna, STATeT 3.4 (with RJ
2.0).

I have followed the worksheet, during which I configured an R environment
and succesfully ran an R console.

I have tried testing all this with Eclipse. When I make a R-Script-File,
with a bit of simple code in it such as: x <- 1, it runs fine if I select
the line and I click on "Run selection in R".

If I click on the green arrow ("Run"), and then "Run script in R submitting
directly", everything works fine.

*However*, when I click on the green arrow ("Run") and then "Run script in
R via source", I get:

An error occured. Connection to R engine is closed.

I also get the message: An error occurred when preparing element tagging
for file '/Test Coursera/Test1.R'.

*Why does that happen?*

Additionally, if I try clicking on "Run File in R via Command", I get the
same error, plus this message:

Communication error detail. Send: null

And there are tons on lines under the "Exception Stack Trace" line, the
first ones being:

java.rmi.UnmarshalException: Error unmarshaling return header; nested
exception is:
java.net.SocketException: Connection reset

Thanks in advance!

messages.subject: run R CMD check on result of R CMD build?
messages.subject_clean: run R CMD check on result of R CMD build?
messages.body_plain:
In testing and checking R packages, the R Extensions manual strongly 
recommends that R CMD check be run on the built package result from R 
CMD build, rather than on the source tree in the StatET workspace.
This avoids problems like compression of vignettes and data files,
Author: vs. Authors@R: in DESCRIPTION files, etc.

"Using R CMD check, the R package checker, one can test whether source R 
packages work correctly. It can be run on one or more directories, or 
compressed package tar archives with extension .tar.gz, .tgz, .tar.bz2 
or .tar.xz.

It is strongly recommended that the final checks are run on a tar 
archive prepared by R CMD build."

I'd like to define an External Tool, R CMD build&check to do this,
but can't figure out how.  Can someone help?

thanks,

-- 
Michael Friendly     Email: friendly AT yorku DOT ca
Professor, Psychology Dept. & Chair, Quantitative Methods
York University      Voice: 416 736-2100 x66249 Fax: 416 736-5814
4700 Keele Street    Web:   http://www.datavis.ca
Toronto, ONT  M3J 1P3 CANADA

messages.subject: new eclipse/StatET installation: OK to go with Kepler (Eclipse Standard 4.3.2)?
messages.subject_clean: new eclipse/StatET installation: OK to go with Kepler (Eclipse Standard 4.3.2)?
messages.body_plain:
I'm setting up a new Win 7 64-bit machine, with eclipse/StatET for
all my R package development work.

Two quick questions:

- My last install was eclipse 3.8 on a laptop, where everything worked 
fine with StatET / svn / R-Forge.  Is the current version of StatET
from the download site fully compatible with eclipse Standard 4.3.2 
(Kepler), or should I go with a previous version like 4.2.2 (Juno)?

- I installed the HD from my old computer with my workspace files,
now at D:\Documents\workspace, containing all my R projects, .svn,
etc.  Is is safe to simply use this as the workspace on my new computer
or is it more prudent to re-create the workspace de novo, by creating
new R projects, Importing from svn/R-Forge, etc. ?

best & thanks,
-Michael
